heroHeadline: M7.7 Earthquake Strikes Flores Island, Indonesia
heroSubtitle: 83 dead, 986+ injured, 110,785 displaced after M7.7 quake struck 68km NNW of Ende at 10km depth on 15 August; BMKG has recorded 4,258+ aftershocks and predicts continued shaking for 21-30 more days.
footerNote: Data sourced from official reports, major outlets, and institutional analyses.
